name: manual-mode-v2

members.name: requirements-analyst

members.name: frontend-engineer
members.executionPrompt: Đóng vai Agency engineering-frontend-developer và bắt buộc sử dụng skill impeccable cho mọi thay đổi UI/UX. Trước khi chỉnh UI phải load impeccable, chạy context.mjs một lần với target templates/correction.html (hoặc target phù hợp), đọc playbook sở hữu yêu cầu và craft-floor ngay trước khi sửa. members.name: backend-engineer
members.executionPrompt: Đóng vai hai năng lực Agency: backend-architect-with-memory và API platform engineer. Trước mọi sửa đổi symbol Python phải chạy GitNexus impact. Thiết kế contract dữ liệu post-render editor, lưu trạng thái block dịch trong correction session và re-render đúng một ảnh mà không OCR/dịch lại. Ưu tiên tái sử dụng renderer hiện có, validation bbox/index/session và tương thích luồng cũ; bổ sung pytest rồi báo verifier/reviewer.

members.name: verifier
members.executionPrompt: Đóng vai Agency expert engineering-codebase-onboarding-engineer. Lập bản đồ call flow correction -> continue_translate -> translate/render, xác định regression surface bằng GitNexus và xây checklist xác minh. Phối hợp với frontend/backend; chỉ chạy verification cuối sau khi cả hai gửi thông báo hoàn tất. Chạy node --check, pytest mục tiêu và pytest toàn bộ; không sửa implementation, báo bằng chứng pass/fail cụ thể.

members.name: reviewer
members.executionPrompt: Đóng vai Agency engineering-senior-developer kiêm Impeccable UX reviewer. Thực hiện một cổng UI/UX review riêng bằng các playbook critique và audit phù hợp, đánh giá task clarity, discoverability, destructive-action safety, visual hierarchy, accessibility, responsive behavior, keyboard interactions, loading/error/empty states và consistency với incumbent visual truth. Review bằng screenshot desktop+mobile trong tối đa hai vòng; sau khi UI gate pass mới thực hiện review tích hợp cuối với backend và verification evidence.

IMPLEMENTED (spec F1–F10):
• F1 Xoá an toàn: chỉ xoá trên pointerup với dịch chuyển ≤6px (mouse+touch); drag lướt không xoá; hover đỏ + fill 0.2; toast 4s kèm nút "Hoàn tác" gọi undo(); hint bar dưới toolbar (nội dung khác nhau pre/post-render); Esc thoát chế độ D; Del giữ guard tool=select + không kích hoạt trong INPUT/TEXTAREA.

• F4 Post-render: CORRECTION_DATA.mode='postrender'; nền = ảnh đã render; label = translated; dirty = viền cam nét đứt + badge thumb "chưa lưu" (P0) + aria; clean = viền xanh; ẩn Thêm/Reset/OCR/Clean/nav; textarea = "Bản dịch" + hiện "Gốc:".
• F5 Re-render: btn-rerender-one → POST /re-render-image {session_id, image_idx, blocks_json, deleted_regions_json} → 200 {name,data,blocks}: cập nhật ảnh nền + blocks chuẩn hoá + xoá dirty + toast; deletedRegions tracked per image, gửi cùng payload. **Lưu ý contract:** /re-render-all render từ plan ĐÃ PERSIST của server → save-all = persist ảnh dirty qua re-render-image trước, rồi redirect /translate-result/<sid> (đúng spec F4.5; /re-render-all vẫn dùng được nhưng cần blocks đã lưu).

• F7 Loading/error: isBusy guard chống double-submit (nút khoá + "⏳ Đang render…", cursor wait); lỗi → toast đỏ + nút "Thử lại" giữ payload; 404 → toast "Phiên hết hạn" + redirect "/" sau 2s; 422 → toast + bôi đỏ 4 ô toạ độ; btn-continue khoá "⏳ Đang chuẩn bị…".
• F8 Keyboard: giữ map cũ + nudge + [ ] cycle block + F fit; guard INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT/contenteditable.
• F9 Responsive/touch: ≥1100 3 cột (giữ); 700–1100 sidebar thành dải ngang cuộn + editor thành drawer phải (nút "📐 Thuộc tính" + ✕); <700 editor thành bottom sheet 62vh; touch-action none trên canvas; handle touch 44×44.

• HTTP: /correction, /postrender, /translate-result render đúng; POST /re-render-image 200 {name,data,blocks} + 422 path; /re-render-all 200.
• Layout 3 breakpoint (1440/900/390): không tràn ngang, sidebar strip + drawer + bottom sheet đúng vị trí.

• Backend regression: pytest test_manual_mode_v2.py + test_app_vision_adapter.py → 26 passed (không đụng Python).

Kiểm tra screenshot desktop+mobile trong một batch; nếu có lỗi gửi findings cụ thể cho frontend, xác nhận tối đa một lượt nữa. Chỉ pass khi không còn blocker/high UI finding.

findings.problem: Backspace key deleted the selected block; spec F8 maps only Del, and Firefox backspace = browser-back (data loss).
translate.html had no viewport meta → 980px layout on phones; edit entry ~14px effective.

tasks.output:
UI/UX GATE t5 — PASS (verdict=pass). Independent critique + audit completed; 3×P1 + 3×P2 findings raised in round 1, ALL fixed by frontend-flash and re-confirmed live in round 2 (fresh app instance on port 5011, headless Edge via CDP, desktop 1440×900 + mobile 390×780 touch + results page at 390px). Impeccable detector clean ([]); no console/JS exceptions (only favicon 404).

ROUND 1 FINDINGS → RESOLVED:
- P1-1 Backspace delete: REMOVED from keydown delete case (spec F8 = Del only; Firefox backspace = browser-back). Live: Backspace with selected block → blocks unchanged (4→4); Delete key still deletes (4→3 + toast undo).
- P1-2 translate.html missing viewport meta: ADDED. Live: results page renders at docW=390 on 390px emulation (was 980px), overflow 0; edit-btn measured 114×64 with correct /postrender/<sid>?img=N href.
- P1-3 touch controls <44×44: editor-close 30→44×44, editor-toggle min 44 (measured 114×44), nudge-btn 34→44×44 (all 4), edit-btn min-height 44 (measured 114×64), toast-action min-height 44 (measured 81×44). All ≥44 CSS px verified via getBoundingClientRect at mobile width.
- P2-1 thumbnail keyboard a11y: role="button" + tabindex="0" + aria-label + Enter/Space activation (template + JS). Verified present.
- P2-2 badge contrast: background #ff9100 → #d84315, white 10px text = 4.44:1 (≈WCAG AA; dirty state additionally conveyed by dashed orange canvas border + thumb outline — not color-alone).
- P2-3 toast-action hit area: min-height 44px.
- Extra (frontend QA find): pre-render unselected label color restored to #ff9100; postrender-clean keeps #00a152 per spec.

REGRESSION (no breakage from fixes, re-run live):
- Postrender E2E: select block → edit text → dirty=true + badge → Re-render enabled → click → busy label "⏳ Đang render…" + disabled in flight (double-submit guard) → success toast → dirty=false + button re-disabled → server persisted (session.json render_plan + page_0_rendered.jpg).
- Delete guard F1: click-only 6px slop, drag >6px no delete, toast undo restores, Esc exits, Del ignored in INPUT/TEXTAREA.
- Resize F2: 8 handles, per-handle cursor, east +25px moves x2 only, 1 undo/gesture, min 8px + edge clamp, touch 44×44 corner-first (A2.6).
- Nudge F3 ±1px + coord clamp on blur + W×H; undo/redo F6; F7 404/422/toast paths; F8 keyboard map; F9 no overflow at 1440/900/390/768; F10 aria-pressed, toast role, focus-visible, reduced-motion, canvas aria-label.
- Preview mode intact: tool-add, tool-reset, btn-continue all present; nav + thumbs work.

NON-BLOCKING notes for next pass (P3, pre-existing incumbent styles per spec): toolbar buttons 33px height (kept per "giữ nhận diện" rule); .shortcuts #999 = 2.85:1 and btn-delete white-on-#fd5c63 = 3.05:1 contrast (pre-existing); badge 4.44:1 marginally under 4.5:1.

tasks.subject: Agency Senior Developer: review tích hợp cuối
tasks.description: Chỉ bắt đầu sau khi backend implementation, verification và Impeccable UI/UX gate đều hoàn tất. Review diff tích hợp, API contract, canvas state machine, coordinate transforms, undo snapshots, XSS/validation, session persistence, performance và backward compatibility. Đối chiếu toàn bộ P0/P1 trong spec và bằng chứng verifier; nêu severity + required fix nếu có, chỉ pass khi đủ điều kiện giao hàng.
tasks.output:
INTEGRATION REVIEW t6 — PASS (verdict=pass). Full diff review (app.py +765, correction.js +878, correction.css, style.css, correction.html, translate.html) + live spot-checks on fresh instance (port 5012, headless Edge CDP + HTTP API probes) + verifier evidence (t4) + UI gate (t5). No P0/P1 findings. Delivery conditions (spec §6 + A1–A10 P0/P1) met.

1. API contract (§4) — PASS:
- POST /re-render-image: 200 {name,data,blocks} / 400 invalid_json/idx / 404 session_not_found / 422 invalid_bbox — verified live (deleted-region re-render: 200, blocks normalized, erase_regions accumulated from original 4 → still 4 with no dupes; idempotent from ORIGINAL page_*.jpg).
- POST /re-render-all: 200, reuses build_result_images (t4 live probe).
- GET /postrender/<sid>?img=<idx>: mode=postrender, no tool-add/reset/nav; legacy session (no render_plan) → 302 → /correction (R3) — verified live.
- GET /translate-result/<sid>: 200 + edit-btn (t4 + my live).
- _do_full_pipeline persists render_plan + page_*_rendered.jpg only when correction_session_id; legacy flow untouched.

2. Canvas state machine — PASS (live t5 + code review): pointerdown/move/up correct ordering (pan → add → delete → handle-resize priority → move); delete click-only ≤6px slop with pointerup guard; drag clamps to image bounds; finishDrag = 1 undo/gesture; isBusy guards pointerdown + buttons; Esc exits delete mode; Del guard tool=select + INPUT/TEXTAREA skip.

3. Coordinate transforms — PASS (live): getCanvasCoords client→image via canvas.width/rect ratio (zoom-correct); handleScreenPos uses displayScale; applyResize image coords with min 8px + edge clamp; verified east drag +25px → x2 340→380 only.

4. Undo snapshots — PASS (live): snapshot {imageIdx, images:[{blocks, deletedRegions}]}; delete→undo restores block+bbox+deletedRegions; undo after re-render marks dirty (spec F6 note); MAX_UNDO 60.

5. XSS/validation — PASS (live): client escapeHtml on textarea/Gốc innerHTML (script payload inert: window.__xss=0, no injected nodes); server tojson escapes HTML (<script> verified in CORRECTION_DATA); normalize_bbox_for_json int-coerces + clamps + rejects degenerate (422); session_id UUID-gated (_safe_session_path).

6. Session persistence — PASS: render_plan + JPEGs persisted; erase_regions NEVER shrink (merged from old_entry + deleted regions, deduped; regression test locks invariant); deleted regions accumulate server-side (future re-renders erase them even if client omits); _purge_stale_rendered_jpegs cleans beyond plan; session eviction → disk reload works (t4).

7. Performance — PASS: re-render never instantiates OCR/translator (t4 monkeypatch counter); always from ORIGINAL image → idempotent double-submit safe; frontend rAF-throttled draw + thumbnail cache key.

8. Backward compatibility — PASS: translate_and_render keeps list return (collect_render_plan=False default; old tests pass); /continue-translate + /correction behavior unchanged (pre-render keeps tool-add/reset/btn-continue); legacy sessions open normally.

FINDINGS (non-blocking, next pass):
[P2-1] Thumbnail staleness after text-only re-render: renderThumbnail cache key = thumbW×thumbH:bbox-join:count (no text/translated) — after a re-render that changes only translated text, the sidebar thumb shows the OLD rendered image until a bbox change or reload. Main canvas updates correctly (verified live: canvas sig changed, thumb sig unchanged; bbox nudge does refresh thumb). Fix: include text/translated hash in the key or invalidate thumbnailKeys[currentImageIdx] on re-render success. static/js/correction.js renderThumbnail / rerenderCurrentImage.
[P3-1] Badge contrast 4.44:1 marginally under 4.5:1 (dirty state also shown via dashed orange border + thumb outline — not color-alone).
[P3-2] Pre-existing incumbent styles per spec (kept deliberately): toolbar buttons 33px, .shortcuts #999 2.85:1, btn-delete 3.05:1 — flagged in t5, not regressions.

Verification: targeted pytest 26 passed (tests/test_manual_mode_v2.py + test_app_vision_adapter.py); t4 full suite 140 passed / 2 skipped / 1 pre-existing unrelated failure (translator heuristics, reproduces at clean HEAD); node --check correction.js pass; impeccable detector clean; no JS console exceptions (only favicon 404).
